title: feat(components,types)!: retire the raw-HTML html node type (objectui#13449)
body:
Fixes #13449

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## What this does

Retires the raw-HTML `html` node type, as the triage grade routed it (comment 6385669346: "Route: retire, as recommended"). Its renderer in `@object-ui/components` wrote the authored `html` string into a `div` through `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` with no sanitiser, and `@objectstack/spec` declares no `html` component. It is removed, not sanitised; no deprecation alias. Breaking for a page that still names it, so the changeset is `minor` with a FROM / TO migration (this repository's version policy forbids `major`).

- `@object-ui/components`: the `html.tsx` registration (`ui:html` plus the bare key) and its import in `renderers/basic/index.ts` are gone.
- `@object-ui/core`: `html` leaves `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` (it sat there as the curated tier's "escape hatch"), so `getPublicConfigs()` and the published `sdui.manifest.json` no longer carry it.
- `@object-ui/types`: `HtmlSchema` leaves the package entry, `DataDisplaySchema` and the `SchemaRegistry` map (so `ComponentType` no longer offers `'html'`). The zod arm becomes `RetiredHtmlNodeSchema`, a `retiredNodeType('html', …)` refusal inside `DataDisplaySchema`, not exported: a `type: "html"` node is refused BY NAME at `type`, with the remedy in the message. This is the shape the maintainer ruled for the bare `kanban` key (objectui#8802) and that objectui#12954 reused for `cloud:plan-status`.
- `@object-ui/cli`: `known-schema-types.ts` regenerated (`node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs`; its `--check` answers OK), so `objectui check` no longer counts `html` / `ui:html`.
- Docs: `content/docs/components/basic/html.mdx` (it said "Render raw HTML content safely", which was false), its `meta.json` row and its index link are gone; `guide/react-pages.md` says there is no raw-HTML block on either page tier. The schema-catalog example `components-basic-html/basic-html.json` is gone and the catalog index regenerated (`scripts/regenerate-catalog-index.py`; `--check` OK).
- `@object-ui/fields`: `html` stays in `FIELD_TYPES_SKIP_FALLBACK`, moved from the "bare-name collision" group to a retired-key note. No behaviour change: the field editor still stands down from the bare key, so a stale node draws the unknown-component panel, never a rich-text editor.

The `html` FIELD type (`HtmlFieldMetadata`, drawn by `field:html`, value displayed through the rehype-sanitize path objectui#13431 landed) is a different layer and is untouched.

## Reach, measured before and after (not a source-grep claim)

A temporary probe rendered both doors through the real `SchemaRenderer` and the full console registration graph (`@object-ui/components` plus `apps/console/src/register-plugins`), with a payload of an `img` element carrying an `onerror` attribute plus a bold element:

| door | base `a3c0da9` | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| JSON node `{ "type": "html", "html": PAYLOAD }` | injected: the `img` with its `onerror` attribute is in the DOM | unknown-component panel (OBJUI-001), payload shown escaped as text |
| `kind: 'html'` page whose source writes an `html` tag carrying an `html` attribute | compile reports ZERO diagnostics; the `img` with its `onerror` attribute is in the DOM | compile refuses the tag (`forbidden-tag`, `unknown-component`); the page draws its compile report |
| `getPublicConfigs()` names `html` | yes | no |

The second row is worse than the card stated: the tier `guide/react-pages.md` documents as "Untrusted OK", parsed and never executed, could inject raw markup, because the page compiler whitelists every registered type. The probe was replaced by a committed pin (below) and deleted.

## Dispatch hypotheses, answered

- H1 holds: sink, import, `HtmlSchema` and the zod literal sat where the claim read them at `a3c0da9`.
- H2: `content/docs/fields/rich-text.mdx` names `type: 'html'` twice, and both are the FIELD type (`HtmlFieldMetadata` in the `ts` block; "HTML Mode" of the rich-text widget in prose). Both stay. `check:doc-types` had passed the code-block one only because the retired node registered the same bare key, so it now carries a field-vocabulary exemption in `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`, worded like the `richtext` row beside it.
- H3: `apps/console/dist` is not tracked, so nothing in-tree to regenerate for the manifest; the two tracked generated files that named the type are regenerated by their own generators (above). objectstack's tracked `sdui.manifest.json` still names `html`: it is generated from objectui's pinned build and its staleness gate forces a regenerate on the next `.objectui-sha` bump (see Acceptance notes).
- H4 holds: no product producer. `git grep` for a quoted `html` over every tracked file, read hit by hit: apart from what this PR removes (the docs page, the catalog example, the `data-display-examples.json` entry, tests), every hit is the field type, a `kind: 'html'` page, a report export format, a code-editor language, or an HTML tag name.

## File surface beyond the claim's list

The claim named `renderers/basic/**`, the two types files, the docs and tests naming the component, and the changeset. The dispatch's suggested route asked for every other list naming `html` as a component type; those are: `packages/core/src/registry/public-blocks.ts`, `packages/types/src/{registry.ts,index.ts,zod/index.zod.ts,zod/README.md}`, `packages/types/examples/data-display-examples.json`, `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts` (generated), `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` (regroup and comment only), the catalog example and its generated index, `scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` (one exemption), `content/docs/guide/react-pages.md`, and count / list pins in `apps/console`, `packages/app-shell`, `packages/cli`, `packages/fields`, `packages/types`. No governed surface: `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over all 31 paths answers "NOT GOVERNED — 31 path(s) checked against 6 governed surface(s); none matched."

## Pins (each red on the pre-fix implementation, see Ablation)

- `apps/console/src/__tests__/html-node-retired-13449.test.tsx` — the `kind: 'html'` page refuses the tag and renders no authored markup; the JSON node renders no authored markup; neither registry key survives while `field:html` does; CONTROL: the same page without the tag renders its `p` text.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/html-node-retired-13449.test.ts` — compile-time: no `html` member in `DataDisplaySchema`, no `'html'` in `ComponentType`, with non-vacuity siblings; runtime: a `custom` issue at `type` naming the retired type and both replacements; CONTROLS: a sibling node still parses, an unknown literal takes the generic path without the retirement text, and a form with an `html` FIELD still validates.
- `packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` — the strict face (`objectui validate`) refuses `html` by name; the namespaced refused-at-type pin falls 307 to 306 (`ui:html` left the registry).
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/basic-renderers.test.tsx`, `packages/fields/src/__tests__/registry-collision.test.ts` — the old "renders HTML" / "bare html is the display widget" assertions became absence pins with lit controls.
- Shifted counts and lists: `zod-mirror-parity` (pair moved to `EXCLUSIONS`, 205 to 204), `content-channel-family-d-9256` (row left, 67 to 66), `arm-named-export-8784` (`ABSENT_BY_DECISION` row), `public-contract` and `html-tier-manifest` in `apps/console`, `widget-dom-leak-sweep` in `app-shell` (target and ledger counts re-derived without `ui:html`).

## Ablation (one-shot, not committed)

With the fix committed at `bfd3722`, the nine implementation files were put back from `a3c0da9` (`git checkout a3c0da9 -- …`, which restores `html.tsx` too), landing proved on disk by count (`register('html'` 1, the `import './html';` line 1, the `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` `'html',` row 1, `export const HtmlSchema = BaseSchema.extend` 1, `RetiredHtmlNodeSchema` 0). Tests resolve `@object-ui/*` through the root vitest `resolve.alias` to `src`, so no rebuild is in the path. The five pin files: `Test Files 5 failed (5)`, `Tests 11 failed | 65 passed (76)`: every new assertion red, every control green. Restore leg from `HEAD` inside a trap: `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, `git status --porcelain` 0 lines, `html.tsx` absent, every restored path's hash equals its `HEAD` blob.

## Local verification

Union run at `3c6faea` (the head before the last commit), each exit captured to a file before reading, under the shared verify lock:

- `vitest run packages/types/ packages/core/ packages/sdui-parser/ packages/cli/ examples/schema-catalog/`: `Test Files 697 passed (697)`, `Tests 17792 passed | 27 skipped (17819)`.
- `vitest run packages/components/ packages/fields/`: `Test Files 705 passed | 2 skipped (707)`, `Tests 8517 passed | 31 skipped (8548)`.
- `vitest run apps/console/`: `Test Files 243 passed (243)`, `Tests 2460 passed (2460)`.
- 48 reader files outside those packages (every test that names `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`, `getPublicConfigs`, `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES`, `FIELD_TYPES_SKIP_FALLBACK`, the examples file, the catalog, `react-pages.md`, `ui:html`, or the edited doc-types gate, plus `unit-registry-absence-collision`): `Test Files 48 passed (48)`, `Tests 1543 passed | 16 skipped (1559)`.
- type-check: `core`, `components`, `fields`, `cli` exit 0; `types` exit 2 on one vacuous compile-time pin in the new test file (`'kbd'` is not a `SchemaRegistry` key), fixed in `bfd3722`.

Re-run at the final head `bfd3722` (it changes only that one test file): `type-check` of `types`, `core`, `components`, `fields`, `cli` all exit 0; the changed file `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 6 passed (6)`. Gates at `bfd3722`, all exit 0: `check:doc-types`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:docs-route-closure`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:new-line-citations` (VERDICT 0 new citations), `check:control-bytes`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:doc-json`, `check-changeset-presence` ("22 source file(s) of 7 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `regenerate-catalog-index.py --check`, `regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs --check`.

NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI: `check:sdui-registration-pins` (exit 2, needs a console build), `check:readme-exports`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples` (exit 2 / collapsed population, need the wider package build), and the `apps/console` and `packages/app-shell` type-checks (need the whole build closure).

## Acceptance notes

- objectstack's repo-root `sdui.manifest.json` names `html` (`"description": "Raw HTML content"`). It is generated from objectui's pinned build by `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, and `check-sdui-manifest`'s staleness check forces the regenerate on the next `.objectui-sha` bump, which drops the entry. Carrier: that pin bump. Until then objectstack's server-side `validateJsxPages` still admits the tag, while the console's own compile already refuses it.
- objectstack's ADR-0080 table names `renderers/basic/html.tsx` as the "today unsafe" escape hatch the constrained JSX tier "replaces"; this PR completes that replacement. The ADR is a dated decision record and is left as written.
- `docs/audits/2026-08-zod-to-json-schema-fidelity.md` still lists `HtmlSchema`: a dated audit, left as written.
